In timeline "main", a tween on scale of #f07-shooting-af ends at 27.220 s, 0.040 s after a later tween on scale ends at 27.180 s. For that tail the earlier tween takes scale back and leaves its own end value on screen, so the later tween's end never shows. End the earlier tween by 27.120 s, or add overwrite: "auto" to the later tween.
